subject: Launch: evaluation playbook & evidence contacts (Acme Health)
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Amira Khouri <amira.khouri@acmehealth.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-30T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Launch: evaluation playbook & evidence contacts (Acme Health)

Hi Amira / Samir —

Thanks again for the time last week. As discussed, I wanted to kick off a short evaluation playbook so we have clear owners and a realistic close timeline for procurement. Attached is a first-pass playbook and an evidence checklist to map to controls.

High-level proposed plan (suggested durations):
- Week 1 (Oct 4–Oct 8): discovery & scope confirmation (PII, systems in scope, endpoints)
- Week 2 (Oct 11–Oct 15): evidence collection (control artifacts, config screenshots, attestations)
- Week 3 (Oct 18–Oct 22): review, follow-ups, demo of policy/config items -> target decision by Oct 22

Requests / asks:
- Please confirm your GRC / evidence POC(s) and procurement contact so we can populate the mutual action plan.
- If you have an existing evidence inventory export (CSV/Sheets), please attach it — that will speed up mapping to the checklist.
- Any nonstandard data handling items (e.g., cross-region replication, unusual retention) call them out now so we can route correctly.

Attachments: RI-eval-playbook-v1.xlsx, Evidence-Checklist.pdf (control mapping template).

If that timeline looks reasonable, would you share 30-minute windows for a kickoff this week? I can run the sync and bring Marcus (infra) and Priya (legal) to confirm owners.

Cheers,
Olga
Olga Petrov
Senior GTM Security
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: RI-eval-playbook-v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]
[Attachment: Evidence-Checklist.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Amira Khouri <amira.khouri@acmehealth.com>

Cc: Nora Wallace <nora.wallace@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2026-09-30T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Launch: evaluation playbook & evidence contacts (Acme Health)

Hi Olga —

Thanks for sending this over and for the clear plan. We’re aligned and I’ve added the immediate stakeholders on our side below: 
- Samir Patel — Security Engineer (samir.patel@acmehealth.com) — primary technical POC
- Nora Wallace — GRC Manager (nora.wallace@acmehealth.com) — primary evidence coordinator
- Ben Torres — Procurement (ben.torres@procureco.com) — contracting point (please include on later threads about T&Cs/pricing)

I attached our scope export (Acme_PII_scope.csv) which highlights product endpoints that process PHI. Two quick items for the evidence checklist: 
1) Encryption in transit: we use TLS1.2/1.3 with internal certs — please confirm if you need cipher specifics or cert chains.
2) Data retention: we have a 7-year retention policy for patient records; however, application logs are 90 days — we may need guidance on how Redwood surfaces retention controls to our auditors.

For kickoff this week, we are available Oct 1 10:00–11:00 PT or Oct 2 15:00–16:00 PT. Either works for Nora and me.

Best,
Amira
Amira Khouri
Director, Information Security
Acme Health
[Attachment: Acme_PII_scope.csv (text/csv)]

- Data handling POC (infra/security): Marcus Lin (marcus.lin@redwood.com) — will collect runtime config screenshots and network diagrams.
- Legal / policy POC: Priya Natarajan (priya.natarajan@redwood.com) — will own contractual questions and data retention language.

Proposed small change to the timeline to allow for artifact ingestion:
- Week 1 (discovery): Oct 4–8 (confirm)
- Week 2 (artifact upload + initial mapping): Oct 11–15 — aim to have evidence files uploaded to the share by Oct 13 so we can map quickly
- Week 3 (technical follow-ups and demo): Oct 18–22 — demo and evidence Q&A; target procurement decision by Oct 22

Operational asks for Acme team: please put artifacts into a shared folder or provide a drive export link (we can ingest CSVs and PDFs). If you have control IDs from your auditor (SOC/ISO references), include them and we’ll map to our checklist.

Linking HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.com/deals/ACME-12345 — I’ll add notes as we proceed.

- Introductions & owner confirmations (5 min)
- Scope review & evidence intake process (10 min)

Immediate next steps: 
1) Acme: drop artifacts to the share (or forward to me) by Oct 13.
2) Redwood infra: Marcus will prepare the list of screenshots/configs we’ll need.
